notes: Reconciliation-only. Executed by src/validate_payment_performance.py, which independently recomputes every metric in pandas from raw payment_schedule/payment_events (never importing src/etl_spark_payment_performance.py's Spark logic).

rules.description: curated expected_payment_count must match the count of payment_schedule rows with due_date <= as_of_date.
curated expected_amount_due must match the sum of scheduled_amount for payment_schedule rows with due_date <= as_of_date.
curated successful_payment_count must match the count of payment_events with payment_status in business_rules.successful_payment_statuses.

curated total_collected_amount must match the sum of amount for payment_events with payment_status in business_rules.successful_payment_statuses plus REVERSED (REVERSAL amounts net out a prior PAID amount).
curated missed_payment_count must match the count of payment_events with payment_status == MISSED.

curated missed_amount must match the sum of payment_schedule.scheduled_amount for installments whose payment_event has payment_status == MISSED (payment_events.amount is 0 for MISSED, so this comes from the schedule, not the event).
curated late_payment_count must match the count of payment_events with payment_status == LATE.
curated failed_payment_count must match the count of payment_events with payment_status == FAILED.
curated collection_rate must match total_collected_amount / expected_amount_due.
curated prepayment_rate must match the share of successful payments made business_rules.prepayment_threshold_days or more before their due_date.
